title: The Awakening
description: Get pushed to the brink and a power awakens.
body:
![The Awakening](https://imgur.com/LyXYxQW.png) _Awaken your power and master it._ When you load into the world everything seems ordinary, but once you end up in a stressful situation, your world turns upside down. You may Awaken a power, each power has ~5 abilities and is aimed to be equally powerful, allowing you to play your favorite and not just the meta. You must use your power to master it. If you do not like your current power, there are ways to achieve a new power. ## **Current powers in the mod:** 1. Kinetic Charger 2. Teleporter 3. Geokinetic 4. Cryokinetic 5. Spider 6. Shadow 7. Sun 8. Summoning 9. Regenerator 10. Pyrokinetic 11. Storm Caller 12. Graviton 13. Chronokinetic 14. Hydrokinetic 15. Rift 16. Nuclear 17. Scaler 18. Reaper 19. Exosavant
**Admin menu available by pressing the \\ key. (Useful for easy power testing)** The power chooses you. Go find out what you get. Credits: Merlijn: Media (Photos & Videos) Nome\_criativo.txt: Modelling
